content.text: how to identify on osx, which process is listening on port 443

On macOS, run this in Terminal:

```bash
sudo lsof -nP -iTCP:443 -sTCP:LISTEN
```

The output shows the process name under `COMMAND` and its process ID under `PID`. For example:

```text
COMMAND   PID USER   FD   TYPE DEVICE SIZE/OFF NODE NAME
nginx    1234 root    6u  IPv4 ...           TCP *:443 (LISTEN)
```

To see the full command for that process, substitute its PID:

```bash
ps -p 1234 -o pid,ppid,user,command
```

If the first command returns no output, no process is currently listening on TCP port 443.
